messages:
eli: quick RFC follow-up: propose a tiny post-score qualifier that can nudge routing ties (latency vs cost vs region). keep it simple and opt-in per-tenant.

mona: agree. default deterministic, plus seeded mode to avoid hotspots. must be cheap (<150us) and pure.

raj: runtime: sidecar-first so tenants can opt-in. control-plane compiles/validates DSL into bytecode. router treats missing qualifier as neutral.

eli: telemetry: emit qualifier.{id}.applied bool, qualifier.{id}.delta_score histogram, qualifier.{id}.failure_count. Include qualifier_id in trace.

mona: rollout: flag in control-plane UI, enable for internal tenants, 48h sim, then opt-in customers. add alert if failure_rate > 0.5% or applied_rate deviates >10%.

raj: example config snippet: {"qualifier_id":"latency_nudge_v1","version":"1","mode":"seeded","expr":"score + bias*(region_pref - cost_norm)","params":{"bias":"0.08"}}

ops-bot: deploy-bot: branch qualifier-shim pushed to staging dashboard: https://redwood-infra/changes/qualifier-shim :rocket: 

eli: action items: i'll draft addendum with schema + telemetry names. @mona please prototype seeded RNG microbench. @raj prototype compiler/bytecode loader.

mona: on it, will post numbers.

raj: will prototype today.
